subject: Improve maintainability for kvstoreScan (#3588)
reason: Pure maintainability refactor of kvstoreScan's cursor packing with provably identical behavior. The old mask `num_hashtables - 1` equals the new `(1 << num_hashtables_bits) - 1` because num_hashtables is always exactly 2^num_hashtables_bits (kvstore.c:302-303); the removed `num_hashtables == 1` special cases are subsumed since bits==0 yields mask 0 and zero shifts; and the reordered KVSTORE_INDEX_NOT_FOUND / range-bound checks return 0 in exactly the same cases (NOT_FOUND is -1, so the old `-1 > last_idx` branch was never taken).
